name: Coolest Vector.
description_html:
This mod adds several new textures.

Retextured items available for purchase from a merchant (Mechanic):

- Vector gen2 .45 ACP

- MagEx 30-round

- Zenit RK-2

- SilencerCo Omega

- MOE (FG)

- Vector 6 inch barrel

- Vector preset which includes all of these items

In addition, the Mechanic sells a new pirate ammunition - .45 ACP Boom cartridge.

Be careful !

Close combat with this ammunition will leave no chance…nobody

What is this black EOTECH ?

Oh, scientists from all over the world worked on this development, and delivered the prototype by plane.

Actually it was my mistake that caused the texture of the sight to disappear, but the lens texture works, and if anyone was bothered by the texture of the sight, get a sight without texture.
